title: Certificate and evidence tampering detection
banner: CANDIDATE ORACLES, SYNTHETIC DATA, TEST-ONLY KEYS. NOT THE PLATFORM (it does not exist). No Azure resource is involved.

lines.text: A. quantity edited to 9999.0 kg -> invalid: the certificate was altered (content does not match its hash)
B. edited AND hashes recomputed -> invalid: the signature does not verify under the trusted key
C. re-signed with the attacker's own key (their key put inside the file) -> invalid: the signing key is not in the trust set
D. a meter reading inside the evidence bundle changed -> ok=false: mfm-1#3: altered (content does not match its hash)
E. one meter event deleted -> ok=false: mfm-1#4: sequence is not contiguous from 1 (an event is missing, inserted or reordered)
Limit: tamper EVIDENCE, not prevention. Key custody, trusted time and where the audit head is anchored are undecided (D-013, D-021).
